notes.desc: Raider roadblock: a line of wrecked cars, jersey barriers, sandbags, tyres and drums across the road (x -7..7, depth ~8 m, z 0..8) with a gap. The gap is x in [0.4, 4.8] (4.4 m wide, centre x=2.6); mirror with scale.x=-1 for a gap on the other side (or rotate 180 deg about Y). Socket `gap_center`.
